name: NEW Styles · Editorial explainer (complete video)
summary: A question-led, calm editorial explanation: sourced fact, illustrated mechanism and practical solution, with transparent captions and a complete audio/look treatment.

hook.adaptation: Ask a question the supplied topic genuinely answers. Show it on frame zero, use 0.09s word stagger as graphic entrance (not fake speech timestamps), pulse punctuation once, then reveal the answer. No dark dim layer on the bright plate.

captions.adaptation: Sentence case, regular serif, at most two readable lines, 0.2s opacity crossfade. Transparent, no scrim; consistent centered grid inside top 12%, bottom 22%, right 12% safe bounds. Spoken text verbatim at actual sentence times; silent mode uses separately written reading-paced sentences.

layout.adaptation: Mint/cream editorial explanation panel and qualitative diagram share a fixed grid, not footage. Slide a 40% side panel over 0.5s only if it fits phone-readable type; otherwise stack text above diagram. No numbered page counters. Reserve a separate citation row and never overlap captions.

proof.adaptation: Use a concise source/author-year text line ONLY from accessible supplied/fetched evidence, and explain its scope and limit. No P01/P02/P03 evidence captures, invented quotes, data or results. When unsupported, label the explanation qualitative, state uncertainty, do not fake proof.

illustration.adaptation: Draw original simple outline nodes for the actual explained steps, connect in order with 0.6s line draws. Spotlight the causal phrase without a caption box. End on a complete actionable sentence revealed in phrase chunks. Illustrations are qualitative, not product efficacy evidence.

motion.adaptation: Calm 1.00 to 1.04 scale push and <=0.5% drift on diagram only, never move captions; fades at sentence boundaries. On Continuous Line, keep one growing SVG world and camera tracking, not detached scene cards.

audio.adaptation: Use the worker's approved piano, real speech-span ducking and gentle final fade. Preserve approved v17 voice pace and mix; do not invent a chord/beat map or add unlicensed sound effects. Voice off has no narration stem. Final spoken CTA follows the selected language.

look.adaptation: Adapt warm editorial to bright mint/cream with deep teal type and warm gold details. This is a native graphic palette, NOT a claim of footage grading, skin isolation or LUT processing. Keep logo/caption colours unfiltered.

stages.instruction: Open the curiosity gap with a complete question and a clear qualitative visual, not an unsupported promise.
Answer with one grounded fact. Add source scope and citation if available; make uncertainty explicit otherwise.
Explain the causal connection with a connected original icon-flow diagram. No numeric axes or unsupported efficacy claims.
Resolve the opening question with a usable next step, a complete sentence and any evidence limit. Do not substitute a generic CTA for the solution.
